command: const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process"),crypto=require("crypto"),assert=require("assert");const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".agent/tasks/production-readiness-20260917/evidence/git-all-refs-manifest-20260921.json"));const common=["--full-history","--no-ext-diff","--no-textconv","-m","--root",...m.commitTips];const raw=cp.execFileSync("git",["log","--format=commit %H","--raw","--no-abbrev","--no-renames",...common],{encoding:"utf8",maxBuffer:64e6});const commits=new Map();let current;for(const line of raw.split("\n")){if(/^commit [a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(line)){current=line.slice(7);if(!commits.has(current))commits.set(current,0);}else if(line.startsWith(":")){assert(current);commits.set(current,commits.get(current)+1);}}const empty=[...commits].filter(x=>x[1]===0).map(x=>x[0]);console.log(JSON.stringify({frozenGraphCount:m.reachableCommitCount,gitLogCommitCount:commits.size,commitsWithRawDiff:[...commits].filter(x=>x[1]>0).length,emptyDiffCommits:empty,gitRawMetadataSha256:crypto.createHash("sha256").update(raw).digest("hex")},null,2));
